summary: At Luminara Fields, a civilian farm freighter departs with food while a mother and her son watch the shipment leave under the promise of distant Core protection.
settingText: LUMINARA FIELDS — AGRICULTURAL FREIGHT DOCK — DAY

dialogueInline.speaker: Boy
dialogueInline.text: The Crowns won't let us go hungry, will they?

panelPlan: Wide establishing view of a bright agricultural port embedded in productive farmland. Practical cranes and Verge freight infrastructure surround several long tan-and-muted-green farm freighters.
Dock workers load sacks and food cargo by hand and machine into an open freighter bay. The work is busy, ordinary and communal rather than militarized.
The Luminara Mother guides her son through the dock crowd as they watch the loading operation.
One loaded freighter lifts away from the field on four bright engines while workers and families watch from below.
Close on mother and son at the edge of the port, the departing freighter small over the fields as the boy asks whether the Crowns will keep them fed.
